article.title: Physical activity and biological age measured by DNA methylation clocks: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
article.authors: Shan J, Tay JH, Wang W
article.abstract: Physical activity reduces the risk of mortality and age-related chronic diseases, yet its association with biological age measured by DNA methylation (DNAm) clocks remains unclear. This systematic review and meta-analysis aims to evaluate the association between physical activity and biological age measured by DNAm clocks.
